description: Schedule an HTTP POST of a JSON payload to a public URL: once, after delay_seconds or at the Unix time fire_at, 5 seconds to 24 hours ahead, or repeatedly every 60 to 86400 seconds until 24 hours after creation. The URL must use a host name, not an IP address, and resolve to a public address on port 80 or 443. The answer has schedule_id, which reads and cancels the job and should be kept private. No API key, no account and no sign up.

delay_seconds.description: Fire once after this many seconds, 5 to 86400.

every.description: Fire repeatedly at this interval in seconds, 60 to 86400, until 24 hours after creation.

fire_at.description: Fire once at this Unix time, 5 seconds to 24 hours ahead.

payload.description: Any JSON, at most 32 KB. Defaults to {}.

url.description: The public http or https URL to POST to, with a host name rather than an IP address, on port 80 or 443.

name: schedule_webhook
title: Schedule a webhook
